purpose: Our university teaching project explores chronic kidney disease and eGFR for a clinical epidemiology curriculum.
question: Provide pseudonymised observations for patients with CKD; report cohort counts and mean eGFR by region.
definitions: CKD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Use the latest eGFR per patient; patients without an eGFR are left out.
Report per region: patients with CKD who have an eGFR value and mean eGFR with one decimal.
